sql: SELECT start_station_id FROM trip ORDER BY duration ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.date, T1.min_dew_point_f FROM weather AS T1 JOIN station AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip_code WHERE T1.min_dew_point_f < (SELECT MIN(min_dew_point_f) FROM weather WHERE T1.zip_code = 94107);
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) FROM station AS T1 JOIN station AS T2 ON T1.city = T2.city GROUP BY T1.city, T1.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15;
SELECT date FROM weather WHERE max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f ORDER BY MAX(date) LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM weather;
SELECT T1.name FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.aid = T2.aid WHERE T2.flno = 99;
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.aid = T2.aid GROUP BY T1.aid, T1.name;
SELECT Official_native_language FROM country WHERE Official_native_language ILIKE '%English%';
SELECT Draft_Pick_Number, Draft_Class FROM MATCH_SEASON WHERE POSITION = 'Defender';
SELECT COUNT(*), player FROM player GROUP BY player;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT college) FROM MATCH_season AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.Player = T2.Player_ID WHERE T1.Team = 1 AND T1.Country = 1;
SELECT POSITION FROM MATCH_SEASON GROUP BY POSITION ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom WHERE building <> 'Lamberton';
SELECT MIN(T1.salary) FROM department AS T1 JOIN instructor AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name;
SELECT SUM(t1.tot_cred), dept_name FROM student AS t1 JOIN takes AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.id JOIN course AS t3 ON t2.course_id = t3.course_id WHERE t3.dept_name <> 'TODAY' GROUP BY dept_name;
SELECT T1.name, T1.salary FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN advisor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.i_id JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.s_id = T3.id WHERE T3.dept_name = 'Math';
SELECT name FROM instructor EXCEPT SELECT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN teaches AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.course_id JOIN SECTION AS T3 ON T2.sec_id = T3.sec_id WHERE T3.semester = 'Spring';
SELECT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name WHERE T2.dept_name = 'Comp. Sci.' AND T1.salary > 80000;
SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE YEAR = 2009 EXCEPT SELECT course_id FROM SECTION WHERE YEAR = 2010;
SELECT T2.Team FROM elimination AS T1 JOIN wrestler AS T2 ON T1.wrestler_id = T2.wrestler_id GROUP BY T1.wrestler_id, T2.Team HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
SELECT LOCATION FROM wrestler GROUP BY LOCATION HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT AVG(Years_working), COUNT(*), T1.role_type FROM journalist AS T1 JOIN news_report AS T2 ON T1.journalist_id = T2.journalist_id WHERE T2.work_type = 'Host' GROUP BY T1.role_type;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM student_course_enrolment;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_tests_taken WHERE test_result = 'Fail';
SELECT login_name FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Ward';
SELECT date_of_latest_logon FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Jaskolski' OR family_name = 'Langosh';
SELECT date_of_latest_logon FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Jaskolski' OR family_name = 'Langosh';
SELECT T1.subject_id, T1.subject_name, COUNT(*) FROM subjects AS T1 JOIN courses AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.subject_id GROUP BY T1.subject_id, T1.subject_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC;
SELECT T1.course_name FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_enrolment AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id, T1.course_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.course_name, T1.course_description FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_enrolment AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_id, T1.course_name, T1.course_description HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT T2.date_test_taken FROM Student_Tests_Taken AS T1 JOIN STUDENTS AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.date_test_taken = 'Fail';
SELECT Headquarters FROM company GROUP BY Headquarters ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT District_name, City_Population FROM district WHERE City_Population BETWEEN 200000 AND 2000000;
SELECT T1.product FROM product AS T1 JOIN store_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.Product_ID WHERE T2.store_name = 'Miramichi';
SELECT product FROM product WHERE max_page_size = 'A4' INTERSECT SELECT product FROM product WHERE pages_per_minute_color < 5;
SELECT product FROM product EXCEPT SELECT T1.product FROM product AS T1 JOIN store_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.Product_ID GROUP BY T2.Product_ID, T1.product ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Ref_Colors;
SELECT product_name, typical_buying_price FROM products;
SELECT T2.color_code, T2.color_description FROM products AS T1 JOIN Ref_colors AS T2 ON T1.color_code = T2.color_code WHERE T1.product_name = 'chervil';
SELECT T2.color_code, T2.color_description FROM products AS T1 JOIN Ref_colors AS T2 ON T1.color_code = T2.color_code WHERE T1.product_name = 'chervil';
SELECT T1.product_id, T2.color_description FROM Product_Characteristics AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.product_id, T2.color_description HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products AS t1 JOIN product_characteristics AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN characteristics AS t3 ON t2.characteristic_id = t3.characteristic_id JOIN ref_colors AS t4 ON t4.color_code = t1.color_code WHERE t4.color_description = 'white' UNION SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products AS t1 JOIN product_characteristics AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN characteristics AS t3 ON t2.characteristic_id = t3.characteristic_id JOIN Ref_characteristic_Types AS t5 ON t5.characteristic_type_code = t3.characteristic_type_code WHERE t3.characteristic_name = 'hot';
SELECT T2.unit_of_measure FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_category_code = T2.product_category_code WHERE T1.product_category_description = 'Herbs';
SELECT town_city, state_province_county FROM addresses;
SELECT payment_method_code FROM Parties GROUP BY payment_method_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
SELECT document_type_code, document_name, document_description FROM Documents WHERE document_name = 'Noel CV' OR document_name = 'King Book';
SELECT T1.project_id, COUNT(*) FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Documents_with_expenses AS T2 ON T1.document_id = T2.document_id WHERE T1.document_type_code = 'BK' GROUP BY T1.project_id;
SELECT budget_type_code, budget_type_description FROM Ref_Budget_Codes;
SELECT budget_type_code, COUNT(*) FROM Documents_with_expenses GROUP BY budget_type_code;
